title: Two-sided C3 scope containment: a declared expected_surfaces pattern that matches no changed path is conditioned at assembly and refused on a PASS
objective: Close GOV-0102 (#232): bind expected_surfaces to what the work actually changes, so an over-broad declaration can no longer silently widen the C7 delegation ceiling while both controls report green.
business_value: expected_surfaces is simultaneously the surface C3 checks and the ceiling C7 enforces; nothing binds it to reality. One of the two records landed under this control (WP-2026-0111) already carries a stale declaration. Closing the gap while two records exist is cheaper than after fifty, and it is a trigger leg of the AET program intake (#236).
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: self-dossier assembly computes the mirror comparison (declared files patterns matching no changed path) and, when non-empty, adds an OPEN Major condition and a held_because line naming them

scripts/badf_gate.py: check_g07_binding (source-change) refuses a PASS dossier whose record declares a files pattern matching no path in binding.changed_paths; recomputed at check time from record x equality-bound binding, never stored
discovery_allowance semantics pinned: files = must-touch (the C7 ceiling), discovery_allowance = may-touch and exempt from the mirror by construction
tests/test_badf_build_evidence.py: assembly-side red-first tests (condition present, negative control, allowance exemption)
tests/test_badf_build_controls.py: PASS-refusal red-first tests at the function level in the scratch (refused on PASS, accepted on HUMAN_REQUIRED, accepted when all patterns match)
badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0103.json; GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine section; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier; reconcile WP-2026-0113
out_of_scope: WP-2026-0111's landed record -- the measured stale declaration is reported on #232, not amended; the record is historical, carries no delegations, and its reconcile is concurrently in flight in #224/WP-2026-0112

C7 delegation-time enforcement (a mid-flight grant against a declared-but-never-touched surface inside a WP that never reaches PASS) -- stated as non-coverage, design work for a later rung if delegations ever carry it

any schema change (the source-change binding is additionalProperties:false and stays closed); skills/badf-build/** (the family digest stays pinned); any other family's surface; #227; #229-#231; #233-#235

making expected_surfaces mandatory or driving PASS-dossier production adoption -- BADF-QA's reachability measurement (77 HUMAN_REQUIRED / 1 PASS dossier on main; the one PASS declares no surfaces; 0 of 95 WPs delegate; 2 of 95 declare surfaces) is REAL and is stated as non-coverage, not resolved here: the PASS refusal is production-dormant until PASS G07 dossiers exist, and is proven reachable by its constructed positive control + mutation kill; the assembly-side condition is the production-live half and fires on every assembly regardless of disposition. Input mandatoriness is BARCHI-3's forthcoming filing, not this WP
acceptance_criteria: assembly on a record declaring a files pattern that matches no changed path exits 0 and the dossier carries an OPEN Major condition naming the pattern and citing GOV-0102; held_because names it; the dossier command renders HELD (exit 3)

a dossier edited to disposition PASS over such a record is refused (exit 1) with the unmatched pattern named; the same PASS over a fully-matched declaration is not refused by this rule; HUMAN_REQUIRED is never refused by this rule
a pattern listed in discovery_allowance that matches nothing produces neither condition nor refusal

all pre-existing tests stay green; badf_gate.py repo PASS on the branch and on the composed tree (the ledger's two historical declarations produce no new red: 0109 is mirror-clean, 0111's dossier is HUMAN_REQUIRED)
each new control branch is load-bearing: neutering the assembly mirror or the PASS refusal turns at least one new test red (mutation evidence in the PR)

test_obligations.claim: a declared expected_surfaces pattern matching no changed path is conditioned at assembly and refused on a PASS; discovery_allowance is exempt

evidence: failing-first: the two positive controls red against the one-sided gate (Ran 5, FAILED failures=2)
green: both modules green after the two-sided implementation (Ran 24, OK)
mutation: assembly mirror neutered -> red; PASS refusal neutered -> red (2/2 killed)

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
